name: ovela
description: Open-source IPTV client for living-room TV platforms.

scripts.prepare:apps: npm run classify && npm run sync:core && npm run tokens
scripts.test:webos: for test_file in apps/webos/tests/*_smoke.py; do python3 "$test_file" || exit 1; done
scripts.build: npm run prepare:apps && npm run check:webos && npm run test:core && npm run build:webos
scripts.check: npm run prepare:apps && npm run check:versions && npm run check:android-toolchain && npm run check:webos && npm run check:bridge && npm run test:bridge && npm run test:core
